Name: Lionel Dibbs
Description: Lionel Dibbs was born in Harlem, New York and grew up in poverty. He claimed to have regurlarly fought rats for his breakfast and loosing a younger sister due to insufficient heating in their tenement. He lost his hands under unspecified circumstances and sought treatment by Dr. Donald Blake (Thor). Blake would later discover his patient suffered from cancer and informed him of only having two months to live. He reacted by going to Stark Industries for a cybernetic prosthetic for his hand. Actually it was a built-in gun which could fire six rounds.
